title: Platform All‑Hands — Sprint & Org Update (Mar 2026)
attendees: Leadership: Maya Chen, Riley Park, Amir Sinha
body:
Purpose: share cross-team progress, risks, and upcoming priorities for platform + org-level items. Format: 20m exec updates, 20m team highlights, 15m ops & incidents, 5m Q&A and action items.

TL;DR (3 bullets):
- Serving runtime p50 for open-models improved ~20% on gpux-16 compared to Feb baseline; rolling canary to 5% traffic on Dedicated started 2026-03-09 (INF-3241).
- Dedicated GA checklist mostly green; two remaining infra blockers (capacity billing reconciliation + KMS rotation) targeted for Mar 20.
- Private deployment pilot (customer: FinReg Beta) completed first end-to-end validation in VPC w/ HSM integration; follow-up audit scheduled.

Executive updates (Maya):
- Growth/usage: Hosted API increased sustained QPS by 38% month-over-month on curated open models; cost per 1k tokens down 12% after batching improvements. Relevant metrics in Confluence dashboard.
- Commercial: two enterprise pilots progressed to legal review (dedicated + private), expect term sheets by end of month.
- Hiring: platform-engineering hiring plan approved for +5 IC hires (infra & runtime), recruiting starting next week.

Platform highlights (Riley):
- Serving runtime: merged PR that adds shard-aware KV cache eviction (GH PR #482) — estimated memory reduction 30% for long-context workloads. Canary rollout to internal test clusters complete.
- Compilation/kernel selector: updated heuristic to prefer fused-attn kernels at seq_len <= 1024; measured p50 token latency drop from 14ms -> 11ms for small-medium models on gpux-16.
- Batching: continuous-batching tuning reduced tail latency spikes during bursts; still seeing occasional 95th percentile spikes for chat workloads (investigating router backpressure).

Dedicated & Private (Amir):
- Dedicated: autoscaler policy defaults adjusted to avoid scale-churn for bursty traffic. Billing reconciliation bug (PLAT-210) discovered — engineering + finance working on fix (ETA: 2026-03-20).
- Private: FinReg pilot passed performance SLA in lab; KMS/HSM integration validated withCustomer-42; audit notes captured and next steps are remediation items 1–3 (see linked Confluence page).

Reliability & Incidents (Jordan/SRE):
- Incident review: 2026-03-03 partial outage (region eu-west-1) due to router config drift — root cause: stale rollout hooks. Remediated by rollback and a hotfix to rollout service. Follow-ups: rollout-service hardening (task INF-3260), automated config drift alarms (task SRE-88).
- SLOs: overall platform >99.9% for serving latencies within target; however a few routes still missing token-level cost telemetry (work SRE-92).

Product & Console updates (Product PM):
- Console: per-route token cost heatmap MVP shipped to internal users — early feedback: useful but needs sampling controls to avoid noise.
- Rollouts: new canary + auto-fallback policy (config toggle) added to console UI — documentation in PRD (linked).

Open technical risks / blocking items:
- Router backpressure during multi-tenant spikes — risk to 95th pct latency for chat workloads under heavy burst patterns. Experiment: pre-emptive priority shaping on warm endpoints.
- Billing reconciliation across Dedicated shards (PLAT-210) — finance impact if not fixed before next billing cycle.
- KMS rotation compatibility for older private agents — need migration plan for legacy on-prem customers.

Action items & owners (short list):
- Riley: finish router backpressure experiment and present findings next week (ETA 2026-03-17).
- Amir + Finance: final patch for PLAT-210 and run reconciliation smoke tests (ETA 2026-03-20).
- Jordan (SRE): config-drift alarm + postmortem write-up (INF-3260) (ETA 2026-03-16).
- Maya: coordinate enterprise legal batch for two pilot contracts and confirm deadlines (ETA 2026-03-24).

Q&A highlights (abridged):
- Q: Will Dedicated GA be limited to certain regions? A: initial GA regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1; expansion planned after billing fix and capacity ramp.
- Q: Any change to hosted API rate limits? A: small temporary increases for paid tiers for select customers — ops will announce per-customer.

Notes to self / room for follow-up (informal):
- Draft a short customer-facing blurb explaining the canary & fallback guarantees so sales/support can use it in conversations.
- Confirm internal experiment names map to JIRA tickets (we have a few naming collisions).
- Collect a short list of top 5 routes by cost (token-level) to help product prioritize caching suggestions.

Appendix (links & artifacts):
- Confluence: Platform Q1 Milestones (linked), Dedicated GA checklist (internal doc).
- JIRA: PLAT-210 (billing), INF-3241 (canary rollout), INF-3260 (postmortem).
- GitHub: serving-runtime PRs (notable: #482, #487), infra repo infra/ops changes.

Next all-hands: target week of 2026-03-23 (TBD), propose 30–45 minutes; follow-up agenda to include: router experiment results, Dedicated billing fix status, Private pilot audit review.

End notes: rough draft captured post-meeting. Please add corrections inline or comment with Slack thread #platform-engineering.
